description: This file contains a PHP class for the Borland Interbase driver, which extends from a generic Interbase driver class. It provides implementations for transaction handling, server information retrieval, and SQL query modification to support limit and offset functionality specific to Borland Interbase.

classes.name: ADODB_borland_ibase
classes.description: A PHP class implementing Borland Interbase specific database driver functionalities, including transaction control and query limit handling, extending from a generic Interbase driver class.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_borland_ibase
classes.description: A PHP class representing a record set for Borland Interbase, extending from a generic Interbase record set class.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if transactions are not turned off, increments transaction counter, and initiates a transaction via ibase_trans.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns an associative array with database server information such as dialect and version, based on the current dialect setting.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Modifies the SQL query to include limit and offset clauses suitable for Borland Interbase, and executes the query with optional caching.
